title: Unified Compounding-Intelligence Mission Receipt v1
description: One end-to-end receipt covering the full loop: preflight retrieval, hot AI cache, L: Hub, Supabase projection, WaveRunner execution, Gold Mine publication, graph dividend, and cache refresh. Fields this repo (CapitalGlass-Cross-Agent) can populate from real, verified code are always real values. waverunner and cacheRefresh are owned by systems outside this repo's access (WaveRunner's own execution loop; the physical cache-refresh compiler in CG-AppBuilder-MCP) and stay NOT_YET_INTEGRATED until a caller supplies real evidence for them -- this contract forbids ever defaulting those two fields to a success value.

preflight.description: PASS unless every retrieval plane (hot cache, L:, Supabase, Git ledger) was unavailable.

aiCache.description: From the hot AI cache plane's SHA-verified freshness check, never TTL alone.

lHub.description: NOT_CHECKED (distinct from UNAVAILABLE) when the ladder short-circuited on an earlier lane -- e.g. a fresh hot-cache hit -- so this plane was never actually probed. UNAVAILABLE means it was probed and failed.

supabaseProjection.description: Diagnostic reachability only -- this repo has no live Hub-publish path yet, so CURRENT means reachable, not that this mission's evidence was published there. NOT_CHECKED when an earlier lane short-circuited the ladder before this one was probed.

waverunner.description: COMPLETE only when a caller supplies real evidence WaveRunner consumed this preflight receipt and closed a mission. Never inferred.

cacheRefresh.description: PASS only when a caller supplies real evidence the physical hot-cache bundle was recompiled after this mission. This repo does not write the physical cache itself (CG-AppBuilder-MCP does).
